versions.text:
(a) Means other than wheel brakes may be used to determine the accelerate-stop distance if that means--
  (1) Is safe and reliable;
  (2) Is used so that consistent results can be expected under normal operating conditions; and
  (3) Is such that exceptional skill is not required to control the airplane.
(b) The landing gear must remain extended throughout the accelerate-stop distance.
